retrievalProfile.description: A mid-century orchestral aesthetic featuring a coarse halftone-screened portrait paired with high-contrast sans-serif and slab-serif typography.
triggerTerms: stippled photo effect with bold type
excludeWhen: modern minimalist digital photography is required

recipe.visualDefinition: A textured composition centered on a woman in white gloves holding a bird of paradise flower, rendered through a visible halftone dot pattern, overlaid with right-aligned and centered vintage typography in white and yellow.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject-to-texture: The portrait is defined by a coarse, stippled halftone screen.
Color-to-Hierarchy: White text for titles, yellow text for artist names to create separation.
Subject-to-Background: The dark, textured background provides high contrast for the pale skin and white gloves.
Graphic-to-Subject: The sharp, angular lines of the flower contrast with the soft curves of the portrait.
coreInvariants: Coarse halftone screen texture applied to the entire photographic subject.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A medium close-up portrait positioned on the left, occupying approximately 60% of the frame width.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The woman's face and the bright orange bird of paradise flower.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the face on the left, following the diagonal line of the flower stem to the typography on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dense, textured dark space in the upper right and lower right corners.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep brown and charcoal (background and shadows)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Cream and white (skin tones and primary text)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant orange (flower) and bright yellow (artist name)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the subject and background; muted saturation except for the floral and yellow accents.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to earth tones, white, yellow, and orange.

letterConstructionRules: Primary title uses a wide, geometric sans-serif with open counters.
Artist name uses a condensed, heavy slab-serif with thick blocky serifs.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between a light, wide sans-serif and a heavy, condensed slab-serif.
graphicDevices: Small logo badge in the upper left

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric sans-serif title style.
Matches the heavy slab-serif artist name.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a woman in white gloves holding a bird of paradise flower, applying a coarse, visible halftone dot screen across the entire image with a dark, stippled background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add uppercase geometric sans-serif text in white at the top right, and a heavy condensed slab-serif in yellow in the middle right.

verificationChecks: Is the halftone pattern visible and coarse?
Is the artist name in yellow slab-serif?
Is the title in white sans-serif?
Is the composition right-heavy for text?

postGenerationChecks: Check that the halftone effect doesn't obscure the facial features entirely.
Ensure the yellow text is legible against the dark background.
Verify the alignment of the right-hand text block.
Confirm the presence of the stippled texture in the negative space.
recipe.reuseFormula: Halftone Portrait + Geometric Sans Title + Heavy Slab Artist Name + Dark Stippled Background
